name: BracesNotebook
blurb: Explore orthodontics interactively in Unity. Add brackets and rubber bands to a tooth, then observe how it responds to applied forces in a playful simulation.

name: AnimationRigging
blurb: This Unity project demonstrates real-time body tracking and retargeting using Google's MediaPipe via the homuler/MediaPipeUnityPlugin. It takes 2D images, video, or live webcam input and estimates 3D body joint positions, which are then mapped to a standard Mixamo skeleton using Unity’s Animation Rigging system.

name: HeartrateMonitor
blurb: Visualize heart rate data with a HR sensor via BLE connection. Connect Polar heart rate straps via Bluetooth and monitor live heart rate with a clear interactive display.

name: VirtualCoEmbodimentFullBody
blurb: Connect teachers and students in Unity to control a shared full-body avatar in real time. Enables collaborative learning with co-embodied movement and feedback.

name: VR_Hands_CoEmb
blurb: Collaborative hand tracking in Unity for Oculus Quest. Teachers and students interact with co-embodied hand models in real time, enhancing immersive group activities.

name: AI-Scene-Generator
blurb: Create 3D scenes and games in VR using AI generation. No programming required, design interactive environments quickly and intuitively with smart automation.

name: AntExplorer
blurb: Discover the world of ants through interactive puzzles and exploration. Dive into an anthill, learn ant biology, and solve riddles as a researcher in a playful game.

name: 3DViewer
blurb: Explore 3D models interactively in Unity with stereoscopic rendering. Ideal for showcasing stereo 3D and examining models from multiple perspectives.
